:::{#sol-affine-map-zero-practice}

By @thm-affine-map-zero,
$\vec{b} = f(\vzero) = \tp{(1, 2)}$.
So

$$
\ba
\matr{A} \sbmat{1 \\ 0}
&= f\paren{\sbmat{1 \\ 0}} - \vec{b}
&& \text{(@def-affine-map)}
\\&= \sbmat{4 - 1 \\ 2 - 2}
&& \text{(the given values)}
\\&= \sbmat{3 \\ 0}.
\ea
$$

By @def-matvec-mult,
$\matr{A} \tp{(1, 0)}$ is the first [column of $\matr{A}$](#def-matrix-column),
which is therefore $\tp{(3, 0)}$.

:::
